verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's docs strongly claim enforcement of coding standards, CI/CD policies, merge checks, and granular permissions across workspaces/projects/repos (bitbucket-docs-6,7,8,9), but a concrete community report states that as an admin in Bitbucket Enterprise Cloud there was no way to prevent team members from making repositories public — a direct governance/permission enforcement failure (bitbucket-comm-18). This contradicts the vendor's granular-permission claims, so the capability is disputed rather than cleanly delivered. Missing for 10: independent verification that permission/policy enforcement works reliably in practice, and resolution of the reported admin control gap.
